item.title: The Fairy Tale and the Animal
item.description: Everyone has a dark side, and the fairy tale about people is fragile against the intellect. Facing the animal honestly, then protecting the fairy tale by taking the logic further.

item.title: Notes
item.description: I’m Chinmay. This is where I write in public: longer pieces I’m working on, published as they evolve. Some of them are drafts, and they’ll change.

item.title: The Fear of Attachment
item.description: How "attachment is suffering" turns into action paralysis, why the mind takes over when reason steps aside, and how to get back the basics, the spiritual highs and your ambition without giving up the insight.

item.title: The Soul Is a Product of Ego
item.description: Why the usual picture of the soul, a light inside the body that makes it alive, looks like the work of ego, and why I still believe in a soul anyway.

item.title: Spirituality vs Philosophy
item.description: A working line between the two. Spirituality as the part of philosophy built on something beyond matter and aimed at the self's peace, and the corner cases that test it.

item.title: What Is Ego?
item.description: One word for hurt pride and for what monks try to dissolve. A definition that covers both, and why a weaker ego buys you peace.

item.title: How You Sabotage Yourself Without Knowing It
item.description: Three traps the mind sets (the tortured genius, trauma as a badge, and buying certainty), why they're so hard to see, and how to step out of them.

item.title: Microframeworks
item.description: My working philosophy of how to live. There's no single "you" in charge of your mind, and peace doesn't have to wait until the work is done.

item.title: The War Between You and Your Mind
item.description: Why the part of you that plans keeps losing to the part that craves, what actually helps, and why it might not be a war at all.

item.title: Where the Work Goes
item.description: If AI can't end scarcity, it moves it. Two spectrums for guessing where work goes next, and what to do about it now.
